mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of isocarboxazid and other substrates, increasing MAOI levels and risk of serotonergic crisis; additionally, erythromycin has mild serotonergic properties that may potentiate monoamine oxidase inhibition effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or select alternative antibiotic; if combination necessary, monitor closely for signs of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and cardiac arrhythmias.
